name: stfv-forms
description: Gerador de formularios da Se Tu For, Eu Vou! Viagens - monta o form, configura UTMs e exporta o codigo pronto pra LP

scripts.verificar: esbuild scripts/gerar-amostra.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=.amostra-runner.mjs --log-level=error && node .amostra-runner.mjs && tsc --noEmit --jsx react-jsx --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --strict --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters --skipLibCheck --types vite/client .amostra/expedicao.tsx .amostra/live.tsx .amostra/live-bifurcada.tsx .amostra/simples.tsx .amostra/vazio.tsx && node --check .amostra/expedicao.save-lead.mjs && node --check .amostra/live.save-lead.mjs && node --check api/save-lead.mjs && node --check api/publicar.mjs && node --check api/form.mjs && esbuild src/paraServidor.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=.gerador-check.mjs --log-level=error && node scripts/checar-bundle.mjs .gerador-check.mjs && node scripts/teste-api.mjs && echo OK: codigo gerado compila nos 5 casos
